description: Source code implementing extent management for jemalloc's dynamic storage segment (DSS), including functions for allocation, merging, and state management of the DSS.

methods.name: extent_dss_sbrk
methods.description: Wrapper around sbrk system call for managing DSS memory segments.

methods.name: extent_dss_prec_get
methods.description: Retrieves the current DSS precedence setting.

methods.name: extent_dss_extending_start
methods.description: Marks the start of a DSS extension operation, ensuring exclusive access.

methods.name: extent_dss_extending_finish
methods.description: Marks the end of a DSS extension operation.

methods.name: extent_dss_max_update
methods.description: Updates the maximum address of the DSS segment.

methods.name: extent_alloc_dss
methods.description: Allocates memory within the DSS segment, handling alignment, zeroing, and commit options.

methods.name: extent_in_dss_helper
methods.description: Helper function to check if an address is within the DSS range.

methods.name: extent_in_dss
methods.description: Checks if an address is within the DSS segment.

methods.name: extent_dss_mergeable
methods.description: Determines if two addresses are mergeable within the DSS.

methods.name: extent_dss_boot
methods.description: Initializes the DSS segment at startup.
